controles.affirmation: Resultat operationnel FY2026 a 540 M$ contre 1 404 M$ (-61,5 %), marge 6,1 % contre 15,8 %, dont 492 M$ de couts de separation absents l'an dernier ; marge T4 a 6,6 % avec 205 M$ de couts de separation sur le seul trimestre.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 (FDXF_2026-08-05.htm.gz) : "Operating income $540 / $1,404 (62)" et "Operating margin 6.1 % / 15.8 % (970) bp" ; "We incurred costs related to the Spin-Off of $492 million in 2026... All separation costs in 2025 were recognized by FedEx and, therefore, we did not incur any Spin-Off costs in 2025" ; "FedEx Freight did not incur any costs associated with the Spin-Off in 2025". ER 25/06/2026 : "Operating margin of 6.6% and adjusted operating margin of 15.1%", operating income 158 M$ vs adjusted 363 M$ (ecart = 205 M$). Calcul verifie : 540/1404 = -61,5 %, 15,8/6,1 = 2,59.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance de forme : la citation de la preuve fusionne deux paragraphes distincts du 10-K (lignes separees Item 7 et note comptable) en une seule citation avec points de suspension. Les deux fragments sont authentiques mais ne se suivent pas dans le document.

controles.affirmation: Flux de tresorerie operationnel FY2026 a 167 M$ contre 1 531 M$ (-89,1 %), capex 379 M$, FCF -212 M$ contre +1 094 M$, premier FCF negatif de la serie disponible.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, etat des flux de tresorerie : "Cash provided by operating activities 167 / 1,531 / 1,541" (2026/2025/2024) ; "Capital expenditures (379) / (437) / (461)". Calculs verifies : FCF 2026 = -212, 2025 = +1 094, 2024 = +1 080. Le 10-K ne couvre que trois exercices, ce que l'ATT precise correctement.

controles.affirmation: 4,3 Mds$ de dette (3,7 Mds$ de senior notes + 0,6 Md$ de term loan) au taux moyen pondere de 4,79 %, revolver de 1,2 Md$ non utilise, 4,1 Mds$ de cash verses a FedEx.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "we incurred $4.3 billion of indebtedness... consisting of $3.7 billion in senior notes and a $0.6 billion term loan under a delayed draw term loan facility, all of which is long-term. This indebtedness has an estimated weighted-average interest rate of 4.79%" ; "On May 31, 2026, we distributed approximately $4.1 billion of cash, from our debt proceeds, to FedEx as part of the consideration for the assets FedEx contributed" ; "As of May 31, 2026, $600 million was outstanding under the Term Loan Facility and no amounts were outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility".
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : l'ATT ecrit « une partie du produit de cette dette a servi a verser 4,1 Mds$ », alors que le 10-K dit l'inverse — "Substantially all of the proceeds from the Notes and Term Loan Facility were used to fund a portion of the distribution of approximately $4.1 billion". La realite est plus severe que la formulation retenue : la quasi-totalite de la dette est partie dans la distribution.

controles.affirmation: Le CA annuel FY2026 (8,795 Mds$) recule de 1,1 % malgre une hausse de 11,5 % du revenu par envoi et de 8,2 % du revenu au quintal.
controles.verbatim_source: Les +11,5 % et +8,2 % sont des chiffres du SEUL 4e TRIMESTRE, pas de l'exercice. ER du 25/06/2026, rubrique "Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2026 Highlights" : "Revenue per shipment of $415.22, an 11.5% increase" ; "Revenue per hundredweight of $43.79, an 8.2 % increase". Sur l'exercice, le 10-K FY2026 (Operating Statistics) donne : "Composite revenue per shipment $386.63 / $373.52  4" (+4 %) et "Composite revenue per hundredweight $41.54 / $40.61  2" (+2 %). Le MD&A confirme : "Revenue per shipment increased 4% in 2026".
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : « le CA annuel FY2026 (8,795 Mds$) recule de 1,1 % malgre une hausse de 4 % du revenu par envoi et de 2 % du revenu au quintal sur l'exercice ; l'ecart prix/volume est plus marque sur le seul T4 (+11,5 % et +8,2 %) ». En l'etat, l'ATT accole des taux trimestriels a une variation annuelle et double a triple l'effet prix reel de l'exercice.

controles.affirmation: Envois moyens par jour a 86,7 milliers au trimestre clos le 31 mai 2026, -5,9 % sur un an ; tonnage quotidien -3,6 % (trimestre clos 31 decembre 2025).
controles.verbatim_source: ER 25/06/2026, Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2026 Highlights : "Average daily shipments of 86.7 thousand, a 5.9% decrease". Tonnage : .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/FDXF.json, tonnage_j_q = 38,549 milliers t, yoy -3,6 %, last_data_date 2025-12-31 (recast calendaire du 06/08/2026). L'ATT signale explicitement la base de comparaison differente. Sur l'exercice, le 10-K donne 86,1 milliers (-4 %).

controles.affirmation: Cotation NYSE depuis le 1er juin 2026 seulement, comptes anterieurs en carve-out, aucun DEF 14A depose, pas de vote say-on-pay ni de donnee de remuneration.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "On June 1, 2026, FedEx completed the Spin-Off through its distribution of 80.1% of the outstanding shares of our common stock". ER 25/06/2026, titre : "Completed Spin-off from FedEx Corp. and Began Trading as an Independent Company on June 1, 2026" ; "The company today introduced guidance for the Transition Period on a standalone basis. Prior-year figures reflect carve-out results, with costs previously allocated from FedEx Corporation now fully reclassified into their respective expense line items."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : la citation « Common stock began trading under the ticker symbol 'FDXF'... on June 1, 2026 » n'est pas un verbatim du 10-K ; c'est une paraphrase. Le fait est exact, la citation doit etre remplacee par le titre reel du communique.

controles.affirmation: Trademark License Agreement avec Federal Express revocable ; dependance aux applications FedEx via Transition Services Agreement pendant jusqu'a deux ans ; Tax Matters Agreement imposant des restrictions d'activite pendant deux ans.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "we entered into a Trademark License Agreement with Federal Express... that provides us with a license to continue to use certain names, trademarks, and brands owned by Federal Express" ; "Termination of the Trademark License Agreement would eliminate our rights to use the specified trademarks" ; "pursuant to the Transition Services Agreement, FedEx Freight will utilize, for up to two years following the Spin-Off, applications provided by FedEx that support functions including order creation" ; "These covenants include certain restrictions on our activity for a period of two years following the Spin-Off".

controles.affirmation: En cas d'echec de la qualification non imposable de la scission, FedEx Freight est generalement responsable des impots dus par FedEx, en vertu du Tax Matters Agreement du 31 mai 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, Item 1A : "under the Tax Matters Agreement entered into between FedEx Freight and FedEx on May 31, 2026 (the “Tax Matters Agreement”), FedEx Freight is generally responsible for any taxes on FedEx that arise from the failure of the Spin-Off, together with certain related transactions, to qualify for tax-free treatment under Section 355".

controles.affirmation: Verdicts « nuclear » de plusieurs centaines de millions de dollars dans le camionnage ; plusieurs assureurs ont totalement cesse de couvrir la responsabilite automobile des transporteurs ; aucun instrument derive utilise pour le carburant.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, Item 1A : "the commercial trucking industry has experienced a wave of blockbuster or so-called “nuclear” verdicts, including some instances in which juries have awarded hundreds of millions of dollars to those injured in accidents and their families. As a result, several insurance companies have completely stopped offering coverage to trucking companies for automobile liability claims, significantly reduced the amount of coverage they offer, or significantly raised premiums."

controles.affirmation: En juin 2026, la Chambre des representants a adopte le Faster Labor Contracts Act, qui modifierait le processus de negociation des premieres conventions collectives ; environ 40 000 salaries.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, Item 1A : "Labor unions have in the past attempted to organize employees at FedEx Freight and could attempt to do so again. In June 2026, the U.S. House of Representatives passed the Faster Labor Contracts Act which, if enacted, would alter the process for negotiating initial collective bargaining agreements following union organization efforts." ; Item 1 : "approximately 40,000 employees".

controles.affirmation: Aucun dividende regulier verse depuis la cotation ; le 10-K dit seulement que la societe « expects to begin paying a regular cash dividend in the foreseeable future ».
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, Item 5 : "While FedEx Freight expects to begin paying a regular cash dividend in the foreseeable future, the timing, declaration, amount of, and payment of any dividends will be within the discretion of the Board and will depend upon many factors, including... covenants associated with certain of its debt service obligations".

controles.affirmation: Objectif de marge operationnelle de 9,0 % a 9,5 % pour la periode de transition de sept mois, contre 7,8 % sur la meme periode l'an dernier en base carve-out.
controles.verbatim_source: ER 25/06/2026 : "Operating margin of 9.0% to 9.5% compared to 7.8% for the seven months ended December 31, 2025".
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : l'ATT compare ensuite ce 9,0-9,5 % a la marge FY2026 « reellement publiee de seulement 6,1 % ». Le 6,1 % est la marge de FedEx Freight Holding Company (10-K) ; le communique publie 7,0 % sur base segment. Les deux perimetres coexistent dans les sources ; il faut preciser lequel est retenu.
